notes.title: 1.1.1 update
notes.content:
・The volume can be changed from 0 to 10 on the option screen.
・The volume of the scenario voice and the battle voice can be adjusted separately on the option screen.
・Fixed a display bug related to switching voices.

notes.title: 1.1.0 update
notes.content:
・Fixed some spelling mistakes in the English version.
・Fixed a bug that some enemy characters do not have battle voices.
・Fixed a bug where the opening part of some of the CHRONICLES was played with another opening.
・Fixed a bug that the registration of the ITEMS was not saved during free save.

notes.title: 1.0.9 update
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug where the "End Turn" button did not work while playing in Restricted Mode.
・Fixed a bug that the tactics card in the lower left flickers momentarily during enemy turn.

notes.title: 1.0.8 update
notes.content:
■Add function
・The head's HP gauge is displayed during battle. You can change it in the option screen.
・You can change the title screen image to the GBA version as a bonus after clearing the game.
・Added "Restricted Mode" where you can't autosave or undo at all, so that you can select it at the start of the game. This function is for players who want to play with restrictions.
■Bug fix
・Fixed a bug that there was no Japanese version voice when Rosary got MVP.
・Fixed an item drop bug when using Flame.

notes.title: 1.0.7 update
notes.content: ・Fixed the page where Japanese voice is played in the manual.

notes.title: 1.0.6 update
notes.content:
・Fixed some spelling mistakes in the English version.
・Fixed some dialogue missing in the English version.
・Fixed a bug where Cruz's image was not displayed in certain places.

notes.title: 1.0.5 update
notes.content:
・Fixed some spelling mistakes in the English version.
・Added support for using items that do not recover on the morale recovery screen.

notes.title: 1.0.4 update
notes.content:
・Added support for mouse wheel. (supports scrolling pages)
・Added support for right-clicking the mouse. (Cancel operation is possible)
・Added a function to save the screen size when the application is running.　(You can switch the setting of the function on the option screen)
・Added support for multi-monitor.
・Fixed a display bug when using the skill “Mind Change”.

notes.title: 1.0.3 update 2
notes.content:
In the previous Ver.1.0.3 update,
There was a problem that scrolling was not performed when operating the mouse.
This issue has now been fixed.

notes.title: 1.0.3 update
notes.content:
・Added a function to hide the mouse cursor when the mouse is not operated for a while.
・Fixed the screen not being displayed when playing with SteamDeck in Ver.1.0.2.
Sorry for the trouble.

notes.title: 1.0.2 update
notes.content:
・Fixed some spelling mistakes in the English version.
・Added a function to exit the game on the title screen when using the controller.
・Added a function to exit the game with the "ESC" key.
・Fixed a bug that could not be started.
If you cannot start after updating, you need to install “Microsoft Visual C++ 2013 Redistributable”.Sorry for the trouble

notes.title: 1.0.1 update
notes.content: Reduced the noise that occurs in English voices during battle.
